shots.beat: The Chronolith: a black ring older than the building, turning in its sealed chamber.

shots.characters: Kai (foreground silhouette, hands on hips, looking the ring over: the game's 'look' clip); Iven working at a far console (off frame left)
shots.lighting: The chamber dimmed at run time (lab lights 1.2, env 0.14, fog 0.03): the ring and its event-horizon disc (power 0.45) are the key; Kai rim-lit against the inner glow.
shots.sound: Low hum at the ring's frequency (41 Hz bed), one glass partial.
shots.notes: Low crane-and-arc reveal: starts low behind Kai, whose silhouette covers the core, and arcs right and up until the ring stands in three-quarter view over him. Halo fragments are re-oriented at the end of setup (G3frags) so no arc crosses Kai or the lens.

preview.note: g3 review: full-res stills 12/49/85 checked; dark chamber, ring reveal over Kai, halos clear of him.

shots.beat: The first switch: Kai reaches for the ring and the room flickers through 2026, 2196 and back to 2049.
shots.characters: Kai in profile from his left, reaching his banded left hand to the ring (run-time arm blend over the idle clip, G3reach); Iven behind him on the right, watching him (2049 only, so he vanishes in 2026 / 2196 and returns)
shots.lighting: 2049: dimmed lab, ring key, dialogue rig on Kai (focusOn). 2026: amber work lights, scaffolds, plastic sheets. 2196: green-grey ruin, vines, moon shaft (the toy grass cones hidden). Same ring in all three.
shots.sound: The temporal switch (the game's switch stinger) on each flicker, pitched up each time.
shots.notes: DIR.era drives the switch on game time (temporal.switchTo runs on wall time and would be skipped by a frame-stepped capture). Switch starts at shot t 1.5 / 2.35 / 3.15 / 3.95 = trailer 41.4 / 42.2 / 43.0 / 43.8 (the sfx table). Halo fragments re-oriented at the end of setup (G3frags) to stay clear of Kai, Iven, the lens and the sight line. The 2196 grass cones and the mission's hard-edged moon-shaft cylinder are hidden at run time (the engine's own soft spot-light shaft remains).

preview.note: g3 review: full-res stills 12/46/67/90/122 checked; Kai's banded hand reaches, the room flickers 2049 -> 2026 (amber scaffolds) -> 2196 (dark green ruin) -> 2026 -> 2049, Iven vanishes outside 2049.

shots.beat: Sera Voss, who leads the survivors of 2196, at the shimmering veil of Harrow Reach, speaking to Kai inside the lock.
shots.characters: Sera Voss (medium close-up, right third, outside the lock, turning her head to Kai and speaking); Kai small and soft in the haze beyond the veil, left third, facing her
shots.lighting: Late gold of the lock (2196 golden-hour sky and haze through the gate); two warm bounce fills (run-time point lights: one from the camera side, one ahead of her face so it stays lit when she turns to Kai), the dialogue rig on her (focusOn); the veil's shimmer raised to 0.28.
shots.notes: Restaged from the storyboard (camera west of her into the boxy outer skyline): now from the east through the Lock Gate, the hazy golden city behind her (clock, colonnade). VO from mission 13 ("The future that survives long enough to remember us."); her mouth moves with it (talk action at 0.62 = trailer 85.3).

preview.note: Sera close-up at the veil; the skyline behind her is simple boxes.

shots.beat: Montage: Kai's face in the ring light as the room tears between eras.
shots.characters: Kai (medium close-up, facing camera from the ring's side, his banded left hand raised toward the ring, eyes on it)
shots.lighting: Ring light from above / behind camera, dialogue rig key on his face (focusOn kai); era light washes over him: 2196 green-grey with vines, 2026 amber work lights and scaffolds.
shots.notes: Iven hidden. The 2196 grass cones hidden (toy-like at this distance). Halo fragments re-oriented (G3frags) to stay off Kai and the lens. The 2196 grass cones and the mission's hard-edged moon-shaft cylinder are hidden at run time (the engine's own soft spot-light shaft remains).

preview.note: g3 review: full-res stills 12/22/34 checked; 2049 -> 2196 -> 2026 wash over Kai's face, banded hand raised; Iven hidden.

shots.beat: Final image: Kai alone before the Chronolith, small against the ring.
